name: Visual Debug Recorders
description: Two small tools for seeing what an image-processing pipeline is doing: one tiles boolean masks into a grid frame by frame, the other captures colour frames, and both export animated GIFs.
highlights: Lays out masks of any shape into rows and columns with NumPy cumulative offsets
Pads frames of different sizes to a common canvas before exporting a GIF
Class-level API, so any step of a pipeline can log a mask or frame without passing a recorder around

media.caption: GridDebugger: TODNT's grid detector searching a synthetic sheet (fictitious data). A sample of the region search over angles and thresholds, then every line-search candidate, down to the grid it kept
MaskDebugger: the vertical-line features found in each row, one mask row per grid row and one frame per candidate. Lines that agree across rows become the columns
